contentHtml:
Property management services in Parsippany

Tenant placement

We market your Parsippany rental across top listing platforms. Every applicant goes through income verification on the tenant’s share of the rent, a credit and rental history review, and background screening as New Jersey law allows.

Rent collection

Online rent collection with direct owner disbursements. Late fees enforced as the lease and NJ law allow. Full visibility in your owner portal.

Maintenance coordination

Maintenance requests received 24/7. Vendor network covering Morris County. Owners approve repairs above their stated threshold.

Financial reporting

Monthly owner statements and 24/7 portal access.

NJ compliance

PPM stays current on Parsippany and statewide NJ landlord-tenant law — security deposits, habitability, lease requirements, and eviction procedures.

The Parsippany rental market

Parsippany-Troy Hills is a major Morris County township at the crossroads of I-80, I-287, and Route 46 — home to one of New Jersey's largest suburban office markets. That corporate base drives steady rental demand from professionals who want a short commute to the office parks plus highway access to the rest of the region. The stock is suburban: single-family homes, townhomes, and a large supply of garden apartments and condos.

Demand is stable and car-oriented. Pricing to the local sub-market, fast turnovers, and reliable maintenance are where owners protect their return.
